# Know Your Meme & Scientific American

> > A mixed collection documenting viral internet culture through Know Your Meme's meme databases and Scientific American's science journalism.

This site aggregates content from Know Your Meme, the leading internet meme documentation platform covering TikTok trends, viral videos, and exploitable formats, alongside Scientific American's subscription offerings. The content primarily focuses on recent viral phenomena from platforms like TikTok, Twitter/X, and YouTube.

## Key Topics

- TikTok trends and viral videos
- Exploitable memes and image macros
- Viral catchphrases and dance trends
- Know Your Meme documentation
- Social media platforms (TikTok, Twitter/X, DeviantArt)
- Internet culture and nostalgia
- Hood movie references (Boyz n the Hood)
- Content creators (BunnaB, YKNiece, Phillip Hamilton)
- Meme formats (cat memes, heartbreaking memes)
- Accuracy reenactment trends
- Rap songs and music-based memes
- Scientific American subscriptions

## Subscription & Core Services

- [Be in Awe of the World. Read SciAm.](https://scientificamerican.com/getsciam): Scientific American subscription plans: digital & print pricing options

## Viral Meme Explainers

- [What Do The Memes About Hearing Saxophones In The Hood Mean?](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/guides/what-do-the-memes-about-hearing-saxophones-in-the-hood-mean-the-viral-90s-hood-movie-trend-explained): Guide explaining Boyz n the Hood saxophone meme trend on TikTok/Instagram
- [Who Is The 'Bananas And Rice' Girl?](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/guides/who-is-the-bananas-and-rice-girl-the-viral-memes-about-somali-american-ice-victim-nasra-ahmed-explained): Explainer on Nasra Ahmed viral ICE incident catchphrase meme from Minneapolis

## TikTok Trends & Viral Content

- [We Still Talk About You](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Exploitable meme featuring art of girl over cat, viral on TikTok/Twitter
- [I'm Talking About Innit](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok catchphrase trend from BunnaB & YKNiece's 'Innit' with dance gesture
